name: Vertical slice triggers
notes: The m1 slice's trigger volumes (scene slice, mw-e01.4; docs/design/vertical-slice.md §4–5), in world metres. CP-1, just past the spawn-room door, and CP-2, at the corridor's end before the arena, are player-filtered checkpoint volumes: the scene marks them as checkpoints, so entering one requests an autosave (mw-e30.5, wired by mw-e01.7). The slice-complete volume fills the vestibule behind the locked iron exit door; the first time the player walks into it, the latch writes slice.complete = true and keeps it, so stepping back out never undoes the pass.
